description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the ConnectionPersistenceActor's recovery behavior in an Akka persistence context, specifically testing recovery scenarios including connection deletion without snapshots and handling blocked hosts. It also includes mock actor implementations to facilitate testing, verifying the recovery process and persistence mechanics.

classes.name: ConnectionPersistenceActorRecoveryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing recovery scenarios of the ConnectionPersistenceActor in an Akka persistence setup, including recovery without snapshot as well as handling blocked hosts.

classes.name: RecoverActor
classes.description: An Akka actor used to verify the correctness of recovery by matching expected events and snapshots during actor recovery.

classes.name: FakePersistenceActor
classes.description: A mock in-memory persistence actor used to simulate event persistence and recovery during testing.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem and mock pub/sub mediator before all tests.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after all tests have run.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the test state before each test, setting up connection IDs and test events.

methods.name: testRecoveryOfDeletedConnectionsWithoutSnapshot
methods.description: Tests recovery behavior when the last event pertains to a deleted connection without snapshot availability.

methods.name: testRecoveryOfConnectionWithBlockedHost
methods.description: Tests behavior when a connection is attempted to a blocked host.

methods.name: setLifecycleDeleted
methods.description: Utility method to mark a connection as deleted.

methods.name: getSnapshotOffer
methods.description: Creates a SnapshotOffer with specified sequence number for testing snapshots during recovery.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method for creating an instance of RecoverActor.

methods.name: createReceiveRecover
methods.description: Defines how the RecoverActor handles recovery events.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Verifies that a recovered event matches the expected event during recovery.

methods.name: checkSnapshotOffer
methods.description: Verifies that a recovered SnapshotOffer matches expectations.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Handles recovery verification failures by sending a message to the probe and stopping the actor.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines how the RecoverActor forwards messages during normal operation.

methods.name: persistenceId
methods.description: Returns the persistent actor's unique ID based on the connection ID.

methods.name: journalPluginId
methods.description: Returns the plugin ID for journal persistence.

methods.name: snapshotPluginId
methods.description: Returns the plugin ID for snapshot persistence.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Initializes the FakePersistenceActor by starting event persistence.
